header: What the 2025 report says, in five lines
lead: The full text runs to sixty pages. If you read nothing else, read these.

points.title: Mean summer temperature rose 1.4 degrees against the twelve-year average.
points.text: Measured across all forty-six stations, not only the shallow ones.

points.title: Three stations stayed above 21 degrees for eleven consecutive days.
points.text: The previous record was four days, in 2018.

points.title: Oxygen minima moved from August into late July.
The gravel beds below the weir lost a further 8 cm of interstitial depth.
points.text: Hand-sampled at twelve points, so the figure carries a wider error band than the sensor series.

points.title: Sampling moves to a fortnightly summer round from May 2026.
